rows.information: Division of Seed Science and Technology, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-IARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute is an agricultural research institute in New Delhi 110 012. This post is in its Division of Seed Science and Technology. It falls under a PPVFRA-funded project called "Post-Grant Surveillance and maintenance Verification of Plant Varieties Protected under PPVFR Act".

content_sections.heading: ICAR-IARI Young Professional-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be at least 21 and no more than 45 years old. The terms and conditions count age "as on the closing date of application (23 December 2026)". However, the same notice gives 23 November 2026 as the last date to apply, and the application form (Annexure-I) asks for your age as on 30 November 2026. Check your age against all three dates. You need a Master's degree from a recognised university in one of these subjects: Seed Science and Technology Genetics and Plant Breeding Plant Genetic Resources Any relevant discipline of plant sciences Age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, women and other eligible categories applies as per Government of India and ICAR guidelines. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

rows.event: Last date to email the application

rows.date: Shortlisted candidates will be told by email

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: applicants are shortlisted on their educational qualifications, academic performance and relevant experience. Interview: the interview is held offline at the Division of Seed Science and Technology, ICAR-IARI, New Delhi – 110012. Only shortlisted candidates will get an email with the date, time and venue. The result will be posted on the ICAR-IARI website. The selected candidate will also be told by email and WhatsApp. The institute will not reply to individual questions about the results.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and on contract. It runs for one year at first. The contract may be extended if your performance is satisfactory, funds are available, the project continues and ICAR guidelines allow it. The post ends when the project ends. You cannot claim a regular appointment at the institute. The selected candidate must keep all project data, documents and information strictly confidential. They must also follow the confidentiality and other conditions set by ICAR-IARI and the funding agency. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or for joining. Hiding facts or canvassing in any form will disqualify you. Any dispute will be settled only in a New Delhi court.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-IARI Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and fill in the application form (Annexure-I). Paste a recent passport-size photo on it. Fill in and sign the declaration about relatives employed in ICAR/IARI (Annexure-II). Every candidate must submit it, even if no relative works there. In the form, list at least three references from your field of specialisation with their designation, phone number and email. Combine the form, the declaration and your self-attested documents into a single PDF. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 23 November 2026. Educational certificates and mark sheets from matriculation onwards Proof of date of birth Relevant experience certificates NET/GATE or equivalent qualification certificates (if applicable) Publications (if any) A recent passport-size photograph No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your present employer (if applicable)

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in this ICAR-IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one post: Young Professional-II in the Division of Seed Science and Technology, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What does the YP-II post pay?
faq.answer: The pay is a fixed Rs. 42000 a month (consolidated). No HRA is paid.

faq.question: Q3. Which Master's degrees are accepted?
faq.answer: Seed Science and Technology, Genetics and Plant Breeding, Plant Genetic Resources, or any relevant plant sciences discipline. The degree must be from a recognised university.

faq.question: Q4. Which project is this post under?
faq.answer: It is under the PPVFRA-funded project "Post-Grant Surveillance and maintenance Verification of Plant Varieties Protected under PPVFR Act".

faq.question: Q5. Is the appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a one-year contract that may be extended. The post ends with the project, and you cannot claim a regular appointment.

faq.question: Q6. How do I send my application?
faq.answer: Combine Annexure-I, Annexure-II and your self-attested documents into one PDF. Email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview is offline at the Division of Seed Science and Technology, ICAR-IARI, New Delhi – 110012. Shortlisted candidates will get the date and time by email.

faq.question: Q8. Will I get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or for joining.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need an NOC if I am already employed?
faq.answer: Yes. If you are employed now, include a No Objection Certificate from your present employer in your PDF.

faq.question: Q10. How will the result be announced?
faq.answer: The result will be posted on https://www.iari.res.in. The selected candidate will also be told by email and WhatsApp.
